newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCKS MIXED IN QUIET DAY'S TRADE.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS MIXED IN QUIET DAY'S TRADE.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse was 56.5 million kroons
versus 84 million kroons.
* The Talse gained 0.28 percent to close on 259.87.
* Uhispank was the most active stock with trade of
12.7 million kroons for a small gain of 0.25 kroons to 56.50.
* Hansapank closed 1.30 kroons higher on 269.50
kroons on trade of nine million kroons.
*Dealers said that the day was very quiet with prices
falling early to recover some ground during the day.
Trade on the Estonian bourse was quieter on Friday as prices generally stayed within the range set over recent days, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to remain stable next week.
The Talse increased by 0.28 percent to close on 259.87 with 47.8 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"Most stocks dropped in the morning but trade has been steady and prices have generally held," one trader said.
"Next week is expected to be the same as this week with no unexpected information to be released," another trader said.
"Most trade will occur between the positions used this week," he added.
Total market capitalisation was higher at 14.02 billion kroons compared to Thursday's 13.97 billion kroons.
Uhispank was the most traded stock on a turnover of 12.7 million kroons to gain 0.25 kroons to finish on 56.25 kroons.
"Uhispank was up there again but it was mostly block trades," one trader said.
Hansapank turned over 18 million kroons of shares to end 0.20 kroons higher on 268.20 kroons after recording highs of 273.22 during the day.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 8.7 million kroons of shares with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma turned over 5.3 million kroons of shares to 0.65 kroons higher for a close on 75.55 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400 reuters@reuters.ee
